verdict.rationale: The only evidence of background processing is a listed /v1/batch batching endpoint, which suggests asynchronous bulk jobs. Python and TypeScript SDKs plus 'automated accounting' use cases imply users could build their own automations in code. Nothing shows a native automation, trigger or scheduling feature.
